title: A Safe Harbour in a Cut-Throat World? General and Engineering-Specific Primal World Beliefs Among Indian Engineering Undergraduates (preprint, data and code)

creators.name: Choubisa, Rajneesh
creators.affiliation: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

description: Primal world beliefs (primals) predict well-being but have rarely been studied in non-Western students or alongside beliefs about a specific domain. 108 Indian engineering undergraduates completed the PI-18 and 18 new engineering-specific items (EPB-18). Students saw the world as markedly less Safe than reference samples (d = -1.06) yet rated engineering as substantially safer than the world (d_z = 0.72), a premium specific to Safe. Includes the paper, de-identified data and full analysis code.
